author: hsliuustc0106
body: This freezes only the textual diff; later `rg`, imports, and tests still run in the caller’s current checkout. Materialize `head_sha` in a detached worktree (or use SHA-addressed reads) and assert the validation checkout is the frozen head before inspecting source.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: `git diff` excludes untracked files, and this command records only their names. Snapshot the contents of in-scope untracked files (NUL-safe) and include them, together with index/worktree state, in the final staleness check.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: Which source wins when these routes disagree with the live diff? A Direct dry run on #5895 selected Configuration/Serving while the worker path mapped to Model Executor. Please make the live consumer plus repo-local routing authoritative and treat `quick_map` routes as supplemental.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: This creates a merge gate stricter than current repository policy: CONTRIBUTING asks for user-facing docs and an RFC for major architectural changes, not a design document for every small feature. Please scope this to the documented policy, or update that policy explicitly, so the review skill does not generate false blockers.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: The linked skill declares `name: vllm-omni-npu-model-runner-upgrade`, so invoking the label shown here can miss skill discovery. Please use the declared name, for example `$vllm-omni-npu-model-runner-upgrade`.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: This skill explicitly accepts fork PRs, then executes their imports and tests here. A malicious fork can therefore run arbitrary code with reviewer-host credentials, filesystem, and network access. Require executable validation to run in a disposable sandbox with no secrets and restricted filesystem/network access; otherwise limit untrusted forks to static, SHA-addressed inspection.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: Checking only `HEAD == head_sha` does not prove that this worktree still contains the pinned bytes: imports, tests, or static checks can modify tracked files or create untracked import shadows without moving `HEAD`. Fingerprint and verify tracked, index, and untracked state before each validation group and delivery, or recreate the detached worktree after potentially mutating commands.

author: hsliuustc0106
body: This moved to `references/process/general-checks.md`, but current lines 45-47 still require every new feature to add or extend a feature-design page. The contributing policy requires user-facing docs and an RFC only for major architectural changes over 500 LOC, so the original false-blocker concern remains. Please make the design-page requirement conditional on repository policy or an existing owning design contract.
